title: Causa Limena French Style
description: A French-inspired dish, Causa Limena, is a twist on the Peruvian classic, with a low-glycemic twist. This recipe combines the flavors of Peru with the elegance of French cuisine.
instructions: Cook the Lima beans according to the package instructions.
Prepare the Peruvian-Style Chicken by seasoning with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
Cook the Low-Glycemic Rice according to the package instructions.
Melt the French Butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the White Wine and cook until reduced by half.
Add the cooked Lima beans and stir to combine.
Spoon the Causa mixture into individual serving dishes.
Top with the cooked Peruvian-Style Chicken and Lima bean mixture.
